title: Iran to Americans: Don't let anyone turn your kids into 'mercenaries' for Israel's war
description: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei cites a Jerusalem Post opinion piece that proposes US use student-loan and consumer-debt relief to recruit over a million young Americans for ground invasion of Iran.

title: West Bank: UN rights report warns of forcible displacement from three refugee camps
description: Israeli security forces forcibly displaced the entire population of three Palestine refugee camps in the occupied West Bank in January and February last year – and continue to prevent their return, in violation of international law, according to a new report by the UN human rights office, OHCHR.

title: White House website debuts 5 retro arcade video games that promote Trump's agenda
description: The White House website on Thursday unveiled Arcade, a collection of five low-resolution video games that promote different aspects of President Donald Trump's agenda.

title: After a mistrial, what’s next in the Lindsay Clancy case?
description: The mistrial in the case of the 36-year-old Massachusetts mother who admitted to killing her three children sets up the possibility of another trial in a matter that has sown division and drawn attention to postpartum mental health.
